title: Mock2 analysis-limitation waiver (mock2_integration_resolutions, kind=analysis_limitation_waiver)
description: PATCH B.2. An append-only, content-hashed, admin-only record that a provenance-not-established finding was manually inspected and confirmed to be genuinely real code the conservative analyzer could not prove. Routes the capability to pending-operator-verification (NEVER succeeded); the live checklist is the backstop. Refused for any finding the analyzer positively classified as fabricated. A manifest-hash change re-opens the waiver.

finding_class.description: waiver-eligible ONLY for this class; never for positively-fabricated findings

file.description: the file the finding anchored to

inspected.description: REQUIRED — what was manually inspected (file/function) to confirm the code is real

analyzer_limitation.description: the analyzer's stated limitation (from its documented known-limits) that prevented automated proof

manifest_hash.description: the manifest entry hash at waiver time — a change re-opens the waiver (reverification trigger)

reason.description: REQUIRED — why the code is confirmed real

routed_to.description: NEVER succeeded — the live checklist backstops the waived code
